Q8537.reason: Separation matters because the justification you get is relative to which concept of punishment you adopt, so concept and justification cannot be collapsed.

Q6097.reason: After a grant to the cousin and the heirs of his body, the grantor keeps only a reversion if the line of bodily heirs fails, and that is what the later deed passes to the niece.
